## Areas of Expertise
- **Generative AI Strategy & Governance**: Enterprise readiness assessment, LLM use case discovery, AI safety, and compliance.
- **Agentic Workflows & Multi-Agent Systems**: Autonomous reasoning agents, tool use, WebMCP, and multi-step cognitive automation.
- **Enterprise Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)**: High-precision semantic search, vector stores, chunking strategies, and hybrid search.
- **AI ROI & Financial Modeling**: Quantifying productivity gains, computing token/inference costs, and establishing value measurement frameworks.
- **On-Device / Client-Side AI**: Private, zero-cost, zero-latency inference using Chrome Built-in AI (Gemini Nano) and WebAssembly.
- **MLOps & Engineering Best Practices**: Evaluation pipelines, prompt optimization, guardrails, and model lifecycle governance.

- [AI Strategy ROI Calculator](https://sarvesh.website/cal.html): Interactive client-side tool to calculate ROI, payback period, and operational savings from enterprise AI deployments.
